content.short: Clober is a fully on-chain order book DEX on EVM chains, offering a CEX-like trading experience with minimal gas fees.
content.description:
Clober is a decentralized exchange that brings the efficiency of a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) entirely on-chain. Operating on EVM-compatible networks like Base and Polygon, Clober uses its proprietary LOBSTER algorithm to enable high-performance order matching directly on the blockchain. This allows traders to utilize sophisticated order types, such as limit and market orders, without the need for off-chain components typically found in other hybrid DEX models.

Designed as a DeFi primitive, Clober’s architecture is highly composable, allowing other protocols to build on its infrastructure to provide deep liquidity and advanced trading features. By eliminating the reliance on Automated Market Makers (AMMs) for certain asset pairs, Clober offers a trading experience that mirrors traditional exchanges while maintaining the security of a decentralized platform.
